sketch.name: WidgetClock
sketch.description: The time and date where the user is (browser local time), ticking every second in the browser: a large tabular-number time above a muted date line, centred.

props.name: Hour12
props.description: Shows the time on a 12-hour clock with AM/PM instead of 24 hours.

sketch.notes: Simple control, no parts. Ticks client-side every second (browser timer in the JS class, no server round-trips). Transparent background, theme font; time colour windowText, date grayText. Time formats: HH:mm:ss / HH:mm / h:mm:ss tt / h:mm tt; date "dddd, d MMMM yyyy" (en-GB, English names).
